ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Card_Dispute', ISPICKVAL(Dispute_Reason__c, "Charged for a cancelled payment"), OR( ISBLANK(Description), ISBLANK(Merchant_Description__c), ISBLANK(Regular_Payment_Cancellation_Date__c), ISPICKVAL(Customer_Contacted_Merchant__c,'') ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: These fields are required: Description of Issue, Regular Payment Cancellation Date, Customer Contacted Merchant, Merchant Description.
